name: HubSpot Deal "Closed-Won" > Create Wrike Project (from Blueprint)
description:
When a Hubspot deal is marked as _Closed Won_, this recipe creates a corresponding project in Wrike from a Blueprint and updates its associated fields.


**Prerequisites:**

1. A custom field in the Hubspot deal to store the corresponding Wrike project link
2. Custom Fields in Wrike to store required field values from the Hubspot deal
